name: boehringer-ingelheim/hrefl
description: Cross-backend hreflang for a family of independent, path-prefixed Drupal backends (client + hub, with tiered auto-mapping).

suggest.drupal/metatag: Optional integration point for head-tag emission.
suggest.drupal/key: Secure storage for hub credentials and AI provider API keys.

comment: The module generates its own multilingual XML sitemap (xhtml:link alternates + lastmod + priority) at /hrefl/sitemap.xml; simple_sitemap is single-language here and is not required.
